metadata.source: Network Rail NetworkLinks, mirrored by Open Rail Data
metadata.attribution: Contains information of Network Rail Infrastructure Limited licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0.
metadata.method: Shortest paths on source link vertices quantised to 0.1m in EPSG:27700, constrained through existing named waypoints. No straight connectors or inferred crossovers added.
metadata.endpoint_policy: Keep route IDs and terminal names; snap former illustrative coordinates to mapped railway vertices.
limitations: Historical snapshot; not current infrastructure authority.
Geometry-connected paths do not prove train operating permissions, gauge or direction authorisation.
Terminal names remain fictional; station points are simulation locations, not confirmed freight stopping permissions.
Travel/dwell times are distance-consistent simulation, not actual service timetables.
metadata.source_track_status: All 314 selected links marked IN USE in the pinned historical source.
